class_path_note: digital arithmetic accelerator; floor manifest = apb-peripheral (closest memory-mapped-register-peripheral floor; no GEMM-accel template exists).
one_line: Hard-wired INT4 matrix-multiply (GEMM) accelerator that offloads attention + fully-connected math from a host CPU for local LLM inference.

key_features: INT4 signed matrix-multiply engine (16x16 systolic, 256 MACs)
32-bit accumulation with per-output-channel dequant/requant to INT8
Memory-mapped (Wishbone B4) host interface: load weights/activations, START, read results
Software-tiled: any M/K/N (512x512, 1024x1024, larger) via fixed 16x16 tile
Low power (<0.5 W) on the open sky130 130 nm PDK, 50 MHz
Hard-wired datapath; softmax/normalization kept on host CPU

package_info.style: bare die on carrier / chipIgnite shuttle

target_market: edge / on-desk local LLM inference helper (non-datacenter)
